# Sagar Traders website

- Use React, TypeScript, Vite, and the existing design tokens and component styles.
- Keep the site mobile-friendly, keyboard-accessible, and respectful of reduced-motion preferences.
- Use the verified shop name, address, and phone number already present in the site; do not invent opening hours or product guarantees.
- Keep supplied business photos in `public/images/` and reference them through the Vite base URL for GitHub Pages compatibility.
- Run `npm run build` to validate changes.
